image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of an orangutan sitting on a rocky surface with green grass in the background. The orangutan has long, shaggy reddish-brown fur and is holding a bundle of dried grass or straw near its mouth, appearing to eat or inspect it. The face is visible, showing dark eyes and a broad structure, though cheek pads are not prominently exaggerated, suggesting it may be a female or juvenile male. The arms are folded, and the hands are manipulating the straw.
